# [TASK] Frontend: wire chat widget to POST /api/v1/ai/chat with conversation persistence

## Task
Wire the chat widget to `POST /api/v1/ai/chat` with conversation persistence.

## Parent Story
Parent: #197

## Scope
Data-fetching + conversation-id state only — visual states are a separate Task.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] RTK Query endpoint added, following the existing pattern in `services/TMDB.js`/`services/media.js`
- [ ] First message in a session omits `conversationId`; the id returned in the response is stored and sent on every subsequent message
- [ ] Starting a genuinely new conversation (not just page reload) clears the stored id
- [ ] Uses the dynamic base query / `resolveApiUrl` pattern already used elsewhere

## Estimate
**Hours:** 3

## Notes
Depends on #223's component existing to wire into.
